debugging.mcp.read.title: Read
debugging.mcp.read.description: Status, threads, call stack, variables, side-effect-free evaluation, the current exception, the Output window and the Error List.

debugging.mcp.control.title: Control
debugging.mcp.control.description: Breakpoints without conditions (set, remove, enable/disable), start, stop, continue, pause, step, run to, and Visual Studio builds.

debugging.mcp.mutate.title: Mutate
debugging.mcp.mutate.description: set_value, evaluation with side effects, breakpoint conditions or tracepoints (they run in your program on every hit), and attaching the debugger to a running process. Ask shows an info bar for each request. Allow lets the agent change program state without asking; Visual Studio asks you to confirm it, and keeps asking until you do.

debugging.mcp.consentTimeoutSeconds.title: Consent timeout (seconds)
debugging.mcp.consentTimeoutSeconds.description: No answer within this time denies the request (15–300).

debugging.mcp.acceptConnectionsOnStartup.title: Accept AI connections when Visual Studio starts
debugging.mcp.acceptConnectionsOnStartup.description: Off: every session starts as if Disconnect AI was chosen.

debugging.mcp.showStatusBarIndicator.title: Show status bar indicator
debugging.mcp.showStatusBarIndicator.description: Shows which AI client is connected.

debugging.mcp.logLevel.title: Log level
debugging.mcp.logLevel.description: Applies to the extension and to the debugviamcp MCP server (sent when it connects). Open the logs with Extensions → Debugging via MCP → Open Logs Folder.

debugging.mcp.maxWaitSeconds.title: Longest wait for a break (seconds)
debugging.mcp.maxWaitSeconds.description: Upper limit for debug_start, debug_continue, debug_step, debug_run_to and debug_wait. The agent may ask for less, never for more. Applies to the next connection of an agent (5–600).

debugging.mcp.maxBuildSeconds.title: Longest wait for a build (seconds)
debugging.mcp.maxBuildSeconds.description: Upper limit for vs_build. The agent may ask for less, never for more; a build that takes longer keeps running and the agent can ask again (30–1800).

debugging.mcp.logRetentionDays.title: Log retention (days)
debugging.mcp.logRetentionDays.description: Log and audit files of the extension and of the debugviamcp MCP server older than this are deleted (1–90).
